Name: Bathhouse Recolor Toned Down Match
Author: LaurellaBellaBean
Description:
I could not find a decent bathhouse recolor so I made my own, and I made it to match the lovely A Toned Down Stardew Valley Updated mod located [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4080]HERE[/url] by LavenderLight and Minervamaga. 

There are two versions available: a Content Patcher version and an XNB file for those who don't use Content Patcher.

The XNB file should replace the two files located in the content folder and in Content>Maps

The Content Patcher version goes in your Mods folder and requires Content Patcher and SMAPI.

Known issue: one of the stools on the women's side of the bathhouse is cut off. If anyone knows of a fix for this, please comment. Thank you!

Edit: Jenf1 provided an answer to the problem with the stool.

[i]"Unfortunately the cosmetic error in the women's changing room is part of the map. You can't do anything about it unless you change the map."[/i]
